item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 26/Nov/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The weather will be generally fine over Guangdong in the next couple of days. The temperature difference over inland areas between day and night will be relatively large. Under the influence of an easterly airstream, it will be cloudier over the coastal areas midweek this week. The northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China in the latter part of this week. Temperatures will drop slightly over the region.
